$comment: Shared by the domain (packages/domain/test/quoteNormalizationFixture.test.mjs, through claimVerification) and the research MCP (runtime/mcp/evimed-research/test/test_quote_locator.py). `normalization` pairs are whole strings and `expected` is what the gate's normalizedPassage produces; `presence` cases are the gate's verdict (quoteIsPresent). Expectations were produced by the domain code itself; a change to the gate's normalisation must update this file, and the Python port must follow.

normalization.note: typographic quotation marks are dropped, case is folded
en and em dashes become a hyphen
line breaks, tabs and runs of spaces become one space
full-width forms fold to ASCII (NFKC)

normalization.input: 速 效 救 心 丸
normalization.note: PDF extraction spacing inside a CJK run is removed

normalization.input: 阿司匹林 ， 每日 100 mg
normalization.expected: 阿司匹林 , 每日 100 mg
normalization.note: a full-width comma is ASCII after NFKC, so the spaces around it stay
superscript exponents keep their meaning as ^3 and ^-5
soft hyphens and zero-width characters are removed
marks after a digit are units (prime, double prime), not quotation marks
fraction slash and vulgar fractions become 1/2
lowercasing uses the word-final sigma
an ideographic space between CJK characters is removed
a no-break space is a space
surrounding whitespace is trimmed
ligatures decompose
mathematical italic letters from PDF text layers fold to ASCII
capital dotted I lowercases to two characters
U+001C and U+0085 are not whitespace in JavaScript and survive
a combining accent composes with its base
conjoining Hangul jamo compose into one syllable
squared unit symbols decompose
Roman numerals and circled digits decompose
a vertical tab is whitespace

normalization.expected: 阿司匹林--出血风险增加(hr 1.43)
normalization.note: Chinese quotation marks, double em dash and full-width parentheses
line and paragraph separators are whitespace

presence.note: a lowercased leading word is still the quotation

presence.source:
Aspirin  reduced
events in older adults
presence.note: spacing, case and quotation marks differ only
a match may not start inside a word
a hyphenated compound is one word at the boundary
a match may not start inside a number
a decimal is one number: 25 is not in 0.25
a hazard ratio is not cut in half

presence.source: Aspirin reduced events. It also increased bleeding.
presence.note: a marked elision, segments in order

presence.source: Aspirin reduced events. It also increased bleeding.
presence.note: three full stops mark an elision too

presence.source: Aspirin reduced events. It also increased bleeding.
presence.note: elided segments must appear in the order quoted

presence.source: Aspirin reduced events. It also increased bleeding.
presence.note: joining two passages without marking the gap is not a quotation

presence.source: coronary spasm patients.23 Li et al found
presence.quote: coronary spasm patients. Li et al found
presence.note: an inline superscript citation marker is ignored

presence.source:
coronary artery dis-
ease was common
presence.note: a word broken across a PDF line is rejoined

presence.source:
call 999 if:
- you get sudden pain
presence.quote: call 999 if: you get sudden pain
presence.note: a list bullet inside a sentence is ignored
a space an extractor left before punctuation is ignored

presence.source: 速 效 救 心 丸 可 用 于
presence.note: spaced-out CJK matches the unspaced quotation
CJK text has no word boundary to violate
full-width characters match their ASCII forms
an astral letter before a match is two UTF-16 units, neither a word character
an emoji is not a word character
a passage the source does not contain
a quotation of nothing is not present

presence.source: 阿司匹林用于一级预防时，出血风险增加。
presence.quote: 阿司匹林用于一级预防时,出血风险增加
presence.note: a full-width comma matches an ASCII one
a superscript exponent matches its caret form
